chunk-001:chunk-001-candidate-02.proposition: Right and wrong can be grounded in whether conduct harms people or unjustifiably fails to help them.

orphanFallback.rationale: The source independently presents harm and relevant failures to help as substantive standards of wrong conduct, without requiring an opposing move.

chunk-001:chunk-001-candidate-03.proposition: Objective moral facts consist in overriding categorical reasons that do not depend on anyone's opinions, desires, or goals.

orphanFallback.rationale: Even without an earlier retained objection, the source positively defines objective morality through universal, overriding reasons independent of preferences.

chunk-001:chunk-001-candidate-05.proposition: Objective moral rules can be grounded in those that perfectly rational agents would agree to behind a veil of ignorance.

orphanFallback.rationale: The source offers fair hypothetical agreement among perfectly rational agents as a positive secular basis for objective moral rules.

chunk-001:chunk-001-candidate-06.proposition: Moral requirements need no personal lawgiver, just as the requirement of non-contradiction needs no cosmic logician.

orphanFallback.rationale: The source-grounded analogy independently supports the proposition that genuine requirements can exist without being issued by a person.

chunk-002:c002-01.proposition: Moral responsibility applies to rational agents because they can reflect on reasons and regulate their behavior, unlike animals or very young children.

orphanFallback.rationale: The source affirmatively grounds responsibility in an agent's capacity to reflect upon conduct and recognize reasons governing behavior.

chunk-002:c002-02.proposition: Once agents can step back from conduct, assess standards, and recognize reasons against harm, no additional supernatural ingredient is required for wrongness.

orphanFallback.rationale: The source supplies a positive naturalistic account: reflective capacities put in place the machinery through which reasons against conduct apply.

chunk-002:c002-06.proposition: Torture matters objectively to victims, families, and communities even if it never changes the universe's eternal endpoint.

orphanFallback.rationale: The source independently locates genuine importance in the experienced harm to victims and others rather than in an eternal cosmic effect.

chunk-002:c002-08.proposition: Conflict between morality and prudence does not establish that self-interest prevails, because moral reasons may carry greater rational weight.

orphanFallback.rationale: The source positively distinguishes moral from prudential reasons and denies that their divergence makes prudence the sole or controlling rational consideration.

chunk-002:c002-09.proposition: Fair rational agreement condemns Nazi killing objectively because perfectly rational bargainers behind appropriate constraints would prohibit killing innocent people.

orphanFallback.rationale: The source applies the contractarian standard directly, grounding the prohibition in fair rational terms rather than actual opinion, victory, or convention.

chunk-003:chunk-003-candidate-01.proposition: Christian salvation through Christ appears to conflict with moral accountability because an evildoer may escape deserved punishment through repentance.

orphanFallback.rationale: The source independently identifies a tension between punishment according to wrongdoing and a salvation mechanism capable of admitting repentant evildoers.

chunk-003:chunk-003-candidate-08.proposition: Secular moral realism can explain widespread historical error as gradual discovery through reasoning that corrects inherited tendencies.

orphanFallback.rationale: The source presents moral learning as analogous to discovery elsewhere and credits reflective reasoning with overcoming inherited starting beliefs.

chunk-003:chunk-003-candidate-10.proposition: Finite loving relationships and moral actions can possess genuine objective value despite eventual death and cosmic extinction.

orphanFallback.rationale: The source affirmatively identifies the reality of a loving relationship as genuinely valuable regardless of whether that value persists eternally.
